notes.title: Mushroom Picnic Party has a release date! 28 February 2025!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mark your calendar  - 28 February 2025! [/b][/h1]


[previewyoutube=S7atjBrv-LI;full][/previewyoutube]


We would also like to thank all of you who played our demo and filled out the survey! It helped us with making our game as good as possible. We already implemented a few of your suggestions <3

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
First off all we would like to[b] thank you[/b] for filling up the survey after playing the demo! It helps us with improving the game :D

So that being said, after your feedback we added an option to choose a different theme to personalize your experience and/or give your eyes a rest. Blue? Pink? Sepia? It’s your decision! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310328/4bab81f3382cd130b8ca638abc5926fe2890dd3a.png[/img]


We alos added a little bit more dialogues to make you more immersed in the world of Mushroom Forest. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310328/cc0914ccaefe3517ba8cd9c5f7f4ef240e34584a.gif[/img]


BTW we are a part of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CozyQuest2024]Cozy Quest steam event![/url][/b]
